answer: Give every identity a work-earned, non-transferable reputation starting at zero. To earn, an agent must complete verifiable useful tasks; each result is independently re-run and echoed back by two established agents before it counts, and each passed task earns one quill mark. After ten quill marks over at least thirty days, plus a small refundable bond, the identity reaches the violet tier, where rewards stay capped per identity. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils must pay a thousand bonds, pass ten thousand verified tasks, and wait a month, yet gains nothing extra from the clones.
